column1: # Tests/suite-inventory.tsv: every unit-test suite of FernletTests, the file declaring it, and the s3-wall.yml lines
# that run it (ProximityKit plan step A0.8). Pinned at A0.8.0 from a full run of FernletTests at ba1675f0 (642
# suites, 7034 tests, MEASURED on a Mac, 2026-10-10); held to the tree by
# Columns, tab-separated: suite (the type a selector names); file (repo-relative, under Tests/FernletTests, the file
# whose column-0 line declares it); lines (the workflow labels whose selectors name it, sorted, comma-joined, or -).
# Rows sorted by suite. A suite that is renamed or deleted, or joins or leaves a line, edits its row in the same
# commit; the wall's row count changes only with an argued, measured change. A new suite needs a row only when a line
# names it. ProximityKit's package tests, which held rows here from A0.8.2 to A1.3, are its own repository's since
# plan step A1.3, counted in that repository's own inventory.
